subject: Stage refresh: Q2 expansion commits
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Apr 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Stage refresh: Q2 expansion commits

Team —

Quick hygiene ask as we close the week: Finance wants a cleaned-up view of Q2 expansion/upsell commitments for the next commit review. Please update stages and firm-dollar commits in the attached sheet by EOD tomorrow. Key asks:
- Mark which opportunities should be treated as "committed" vs "soft commit" for the forecast.
- Add expected invoice/PO dates where known.
- Note any blockers for closing this quarter (legal/ops/procurement).

Priority accounts: Greenwave Logistics (GW-2026-EXP-4521), Acme Retail (AC-3302), and Helios Media (HE-2109). I care most about Greenwave — they looked like a high-prob close but we need clarity on PO timing.

Attached: Q2_commit_spreadsheet_v2.xlsx, mutual_action_plan_GW_v3.pdf

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Sr. Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Apr 2026 11:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stage refresh: Q2 expansion commits

Jordan —

I've started the updates. Quick summary for the accounts you flagged (I'll update the sheet with per-line notes):
- Greenwave Logistics (GW-2026-EXP-4521): Stage: Final Negotiation -> current contract/discount sent. Sales ask: confirm PO ETA. Sales-reported expansion ARR: $180,000. Legal review complete. CSM has engaged procurement on follow-ups.
- Acme Retail (AC-3302): Stage: Contract Sent -> probability 55%, procurement waiting on pricing appendix.
- Helios Media (HE-2109): Stage: Demo Completed -> upsell interest, not committed; probability 25%.

I'll attach the updated tab (Q2_commit_spreadsheet_v2.xlsx - "Monica_update"). If sales can confirm PO timing for Greenwave, finance should be able to mark whether to include as a committed ARR for Q2.

One note: Greenwave indicated they may request invoice timing aligned to their fiscal calendar (mid-month). I requested a PO date — Marissa can loop the customer in.

--
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
Attachments: Q2_commit_spreadsheet_v2.xlsx (Monica_update)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Tom Hargrove <tom.hargrove@greenwave.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Apr 2026 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stage refresh: Q2 expansion commits — Greenwave Logistics confirmation

Tom —

Looping you in to confirm the timing we offered for the expansion (GW-2026-EXP-4521). Monica flagged that legal is green and we have a contract on file; finance is looking to classify this for the Q2 commit review. Can you confirm:
1) Final expansion ARR: $180,000 (annual run rate) — correct?
2) Procurement PO ETA (date or week) so we can mark the expected invoice date in our forecast.
3) Billing preference: invoice on PO receipt, or do you want a start-of-term invoice?

If it helps, attached is the mutual action plan we shared earlier. Appreciate a quick note so we can finalize the forecast.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
Attachments: mutual_action_plan_GW_v3.pdf
From: Tom Hargrove <tom.hargrove@greenwave.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Apr 2026 10:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stage refresh: Q2 expansion commits — Greenwave Logistics confirmation

Marissa —

Thanks for the note and the MAP. Confirming the expansion:
- Expansion ARR: $180,000 (confirmed).
- Procurement expects to issue the PO week of 2026-04-20 (we are pushing for earlier but that is their stated timeline).
- Billing: Procurement requires a PO before we accept invoices; please plan to invoice once the PO is live.

"On Sun, Apr 12, 2026 at 2:10 PM Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> Tom —
>
> Looping you in to confirm the timing we offered for the expansion...
>
> Best,
> Marissa
"

I will flag procurement to expedite where possible. If you need a written statement for your finance team, I can send a short email from procurement confirming intent to issue on 2026-04-20.

Cheers,
Tom Hargrove
Head of IT Procurement
Greenwave Logistics
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Apr 2026 16:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stage refresh: Q2 expansion commits

Thanks for the updates everyone —

Based on Tom's confirmation, finance guidance for the commit review:
- Greenwave (GW-2026-EXP-4521) should be classified as a "soft commit" rather than a firm "committed" ARR for Q2 until we have an issued PO or signed purchase document.
- Please set probability to 60% in the commit workbook and include expected invoice date = 2026-04-20 (per the customer's procurement note).
- If procurement sends a short confirmation email (Tom mentioned he can), please add that into the deal record and notify finance; we will re-evaluate for a committed classification on receipt.

Action items:
- Marissa: add Tom's procurement ETA to the spreadsheet and push for written confirmation.
- Monica: flag the account in the CS tracker as "PO pending - move to committed on PO".
- Jordan/SEs: leave as soft commit in today's commit review packet.

If anything changes (PO received, legal hold appears), ping me and I will update the forecast immediately.

Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
